$comment: WTG-3001 wind turbine drivetrain twin. Expected power from the published power curve with the IEC 61400-12-1 air density normalisation; expected temperatures and vibration bands from load-and-ambient models; the turbine sends only what it measures.

identification.description: Onshore wind turbine, drivetrain twin: main bearing, three-stage gearbox and doubly fed generator
identification.rotor: 3 blades, 90 m diameter, pitch regulated with variable speed
identification.generator: 4-pole doubly fed (wound-rotor) asynchronous generator, 50 Hz, with a rotor-side converter
identification.cms: Drivetrain condition monitoring system (accelerometers on main bearing, gearbox and generator) + inline oil particle counter
identification.site: An onshore wind farm, hub height 80 m (generic)

rotor.source: Vestas V90-1.8/2.0 MW brochure (06/2009-EN), technical data. IEC wind class IIA at 80 m hub height.

power_curve.source: OEDB wind turbine library, turbine type V90/2000 (windpowerlib power_curves.csv), 3.5 to 16.5 m/s; held flat to the 25 m/s cut-out as in the brochure chart. Reference density 1.225 kg/m3: assumption: typical value, replace with the warranted power curve of your contract

density.source: IEC 61400-12-1 air density from 10-min pressure and temperature, normalisation of wind speed for active power control turbines

drivetrain.source: Gearbox type and generator from the Vestas V90-1.8/2.0 MW brochure (06/2009-EN), technical data. Tooth counts (ratio about 1:113) and the optimum tip speed ratio: assumption: typical value, replace with the gearbox data sheet (tooth counts are needed for the mesh frequencies)

hss_bearing.source: High-speed shaft bearing (cylindrical roller, generator side): assumption: typical value, replace with the bearing maker's geometry or its published defect frequency factors

thermal.source: Expected temperature = ambient (or oil) + c0 + c1 x load fraction. assumption: typical value, replace with a least-squares fit on 3 months of healthy SCADA data of this turbine

vibration.source: CMS band values (m/s2) and gearbox overall velocity (mm/s, 10-1000 Hz) = b0 + b1 x load fraction. assumption: typical value, replace with the CMS baseline learnt on this turbine

oil.source: Oil cleanliness target -/15/12 (ISO 4406), ferrous particles per 24 h and maximum sump temperature: assumption: typical value, replace with the gearbox maker's lubrication specification

site.source: Site about 300 m above sea level: assumption: typical value, replace with the met mast or nacelle barometer of the site

demo.note: Demo only: one real second is one plant minute, so one 10-minute SCADA record is published every 10 real seconds; wind follows a random walk around 9.5 m/s on a warm day so every rule can show.

points.label: Wind direction relative to the nacelle, 10-min mean
Gearbox acceleration at the planetary gear mesh frequency
Gearbox acceleration at the high-speed gear mesh frequency
Envelope acceleration at the HSS bearing outer-race frequency
Envelope acceleration at the main bearing
Gearbox overall vibration velocity, 10-1000 Hz rms
Ferrous wear particles counted, last 24 h

limits.source: Alarm limits: assumption: typical value, replace with your fleet statistics. The gearbox overall velocity limit stands for the zone boundary of ISO 10816-21 Annex A at your measurement position (that standard's zones are for acceptance, not for early fault detection).

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

hss_bearing_damage.name: Gearbox HSS bearing damage (axial cracks, spalling)
hss_bearing_damage.symptoms: bearing runs hotter than oil + load predict, ferrous particles appear, later the envelope at BPFO grows

planet_gear_pitting.name: Planetary gear tooth pitting
planet_gear_pitting.symptoms: band at the planetary mesh frequency grows, overall vibration and ferrous particles follow, temperatures normal

oil_cooler_fouling.name: Gearbox oil cooler fouled or fan failed
oil_cooler_fouling.symptoms: oil hotter than ambient + load predict, the bearing follows the oil (its own residual stays normal)

oil_contamination.name: Oil contamination (filter bypass, ingress)
oil_contamination.symptoms: ISO 4406 codes rise above the target, no ferrous particles, temperatures normal

main_bearing_wear.name: Main bearing wear
main_bearing_wear.symptoms: main bearing hotter than the model, envelope at the main bearing grows

yaw_misalignment.name: Yaw misalignment (vane offset or yaw control fault)
yaw_misalignment.symptoms: 10-min mean wind direction off the rotor axis, power below the curve

rotor_performance_loss.name: Rotor performance loss (blade erosion, pitch offset)
rotor_performance_loss.symptoms: power below the density-corrected curve at partial load, yaw normal
